fields.issue: The correct mass closure still assumes sealed service, zero payload, the chosen weather/water condition, 60 mm strips, 0.2 mm seam adhesive, 1.5 mm core splice and no demonstrated Be/core bond at the nominated film weight. These are explicit inputs, not measured capabilities.
